adjustments.change: Widen the expansion rule so that after checking one receptacle type the Actor moves to a still-unexamined receptacle, preferring a type it has not yet tried (not necessarily a different type), so a same-type unexamined location remains eligible; keep the inclusion of visible open surfaces, and re-express the anti-revisit clause in terms of locations the current or recent observations show as already opened or seen to lack the target (do not re-enter a location just left or repeat a short cycle among the same few locations). This supports the search-breadth direction behind `G2`, `G3` and `G4`. However, `M3` and `M6` report that prior 'do not revisit an already-open empty receptacle' wording was not reliably followed and did not alone break the cycling/step-limit failure, and the protocol exposes only the last two pre-action observations, so a prohibition keyed to 'already-inspected' containers asks for history the Actor does not have. The scope change keeps the supported expansion while aiming it at still-unexamined receptacles (fixing the case where a different-type requirement would exclude an unexamined same-type location such as another countertop) and rescopes the anti-revisit condition to observable recent history. Whether the added breadth recovers the target when it exists, and how much cycling it prevents, remains an unverified expectation.
